COMMON ORDER
The grievances of the writ petitioner is that he purchased the subject property described in the writ proceedings from the 3rd respondent.
It is not in dispute that the subject property was acquired by the Government by issuing notification under the Land Acquisition Act even prior to the purchase of the property by the petitioner.

In other words, the petitioner purchased the property from the 3rd respondent after initiation of land acquisition proceedings and therefore, the name of the petitioner was included in the notification.

Since the land acquisition proceedings were completed in all respects and the compensation has already been deposited before the Court, if at all any grievances exist for the petitioner, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.26800 &
26801 of 2021 petitioner has to initiate appropriate action against his vendor in the manner known to law.
3.With these liberties, the writ petitions stand dismissed.
No costs.
